title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer during regional failover to prevent over-shedding
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: During a recent regional failover incident we observed the SLO enforcer thrashing and aggressively shedding traffic in downstream regions. Root cause: a race between regional failover logic and the enforcer's bucket updates, exacerbated by aggressive threshold ramps without smoothing. Impact: customer-facing latency and elevated error rates during failover windows. This PR is a focused hotfix to prevent over-shedding and improve stability during cross-region failovers. Changes include: 1) introduce a lightweight per-region enforcer lock to serialize failover-induced bucket updates and avoid ordering races; 2) add a threshold smoothing function (exponential moving average with configurable alpha) so thresholds adjust over a 10-30s window instead of instant jumps; 3) tighten default backoff and queuing thresholds for older clients to prevent cascade-shedding; 4) emit additional metrics (enforcer.lock.acquired, enforcer.threshold.smoothed, enforcer.shed_rate) and tracing spans for failover paths; 5) add unit and integration tests that simulate concurrent failover + enforcer updates; 6) include a short runbook update describing mitigation and observability steps. Checklist: - [x] Reproducer and root cause analysis documented - [x] Fix implemented with feature flag enabled by default for emergency rollouts - [x] Unit + integration tests added - [x] Metrics and traces added - [x] Docs/runbook updated - [x] QA smoke-tested on staging Rollout notes: feature gated under `slo_enforcer.hotfix_154321` and can be toggled by ops. We plan a staged rollout: enable on low-traffic regions for 30m, monitor enforcer.shed_rate and latency, then enable global. Related: ENG-2345 (investigation), SRE-987 (incident).

review_comments: Carlos Rivera: The per-region lock seems fine, but can we avoid a global mutex? Please ensure lock is per-region and non-blocking for unrelated regions.
Maya Chen: Addressed in lock.go; lock is sharded by region key and uses tryLock with short backoff to avoid blocking other regions.
Anya Patel: Tests look good. Please add a small chaos integration test that flips the feature flag during failover to validate toggle behaviour.
Maya Chen: Added integration test that toggles `slo_enforcer.hotfix_154321` mid-failover and asserts no double-shed events.
Liam O'Connor: Can we expose smoothing alpha as a runtime flag for ops? I want to be able to tune without helm redeploy.
Maya Chen: Exposed via config and helm values; ops can also set via runtime feature flags pushed from control plane in emergency.
Carlos Rivera: Verified metrics and traces in staging; approving.
Anya Patel: Approving after CI green on rerun.
